name: multi-dimensional random field
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 在多个维度描述系统随机参数空间变化的随机场。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道相互作用的随机分析，将轨道参数的空间位置、随机取值及不同位置间的联系纳入统一描述，以表征参数的空间变异性。

complete_examples.text: The scheme of mapping a multi-dimensional random field to a one-dimensional random field is utilized to present the multi- dimensional covariance function as a two-dimensional covariance matrix.

A general numerical scheme in combination of KLE is introduced to realize the multi-dimensional random field of the track system, which is specified by arbitrarily probability distribution and covariance function.
